title: Exact Arbitrary-Precision Decimal Vectors
text: decimal provides exact, arbitrary-precision decimal vectors R. ’ve ever surprised 0.1 + 0.2 == 0.3 FALSE, package : Doubles binary fractions, can’t represent decimal numbers exactly, tiny errors accumulate compute. ’s usually fine — ’re working money, invoices, exchange rates, anything else cents add . decimal uses decimal representation performs arithmetic explicit decimal context, rounding controlled observable. hood, decimal built : mpdecimal, battle-tested C library behind Python’s decimal module, implementing General Decimal Arithmetic standard. vctrs, decimal vectors work naturally data frames, tibbles, dplyr::mutate(), joins, sorting, everything else already vectors. Highlights: Exact values. Strings integers parsed exactly; promotion finer shared scale adds trailing zeros. Values round-trip .character() without loss — nothing changes way CSV file database column back. Full arithmetic. +, -, *, /, ^, %%, %/%, comparisons, math functions like abs(), sqrt(), exp(), log(), plus reductions sum(), prod(), min(), max(), mean(). Decimal-aware tools. quantize() round fixed number digits (say, cents), normalize(), fma(), same_quantum(), adjusted(), number_class(). control rules. decimal context sets precision, rounding mode, conditions (overflow, division zero, …) errors — see vignette("contexts--signals"). Special values. NA, signed zeros, infinities, quiet signaling NaNs supported throughout.

title: decimal 0.1.1
text: Fixed memory leaks error paths native kernels. R error raised mpd_t allocated abandoned , R’s error handling unwinds past code freed . Parsing invalid decimal string leaked every handle operation held, allocation failure part-way setting operation leaked handles already allocated. R allocation failure storing result string leaked formatted text ; text now released R_UnwindProtect(). summary() now works decimal vectors. reports six statistics [summary.default()] plus NA's count, computed decimal arithmetic returned decimal vector, figures double round preserved. Quartiles use type 7 definition, matching stats::quantile(). Fixed .na(), .nan(), .infinite(), is_qnan() is_snan() returning malformed logical vectors. forwarded mpdecimal’s flag bits – 4 NaN, 8 sNaN, 2 Infinity – instead TRUE. results printed correctly compared equal ==, () found matching elements, sum() -counted, identical() false obvious expectation. DESCRIPTION now declares URL BugReports, CRAN page links source repository issue tracker. Building decimal vector character substantially faster. fractional-digit scan decimal() performs every element moved R C, 100,000 values takes construction 1.13s 0.05s scale supplied (22x) 2.28s 0.05s inferred (45x). Inferring scale now costs supplying . matters loading decimal data ‘Arrow’ database, values arrive character vector one call. New vignette vignette("arrow-decimal-types"), covering lossless conversion decimal vectors Arrow’s decimal128() / decimal256() types directions, including chunked arrays, Parquet columns, cases Arrow decimals represent. format() decimal vector longer errors given digits, na.encode justify arguments format.data.frame() passes every column. Decimal columns can now printed inside base data.frame. arguments tolerated rather honoured, exact value never silently rounded display, unused argument still error.
